house.description: Assessment of fees or other charges when state employees park at facilities owned or operated by the state prohibited.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to State Government Finance and Policy

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to State Government Finance and Policy

additions: (a) The commissioner must not charge a state employee to park at any parking lot or facility owned, rented, or operated by the state when the state employee is acting within the scope of employment or when the employee is not acting within the scope of employment but has written approval from the employee's manager or supervisor.

(b) The commissioner must provide each state employee a parking permit signifying that the employee is exempt from all rents, charges, fees, fines and other penalties, and towing or other methods of vehicle removal, disablement, or impoundment under paragraph (a), except when removal or impoundment of the employee's motor vehicle is required by the commissioner under subdivision 3.
